entries.name: lichess (lila and lila-ws)
entries.by: Thibault Duplessis and the lichess contributors
entries.what: The whole site: server, pages, accounts, lobby, clocks, ratings, sockets. LiGo is a fork of it.

entries.name: lishogi
entries.what: Showed how to fork lichess for another board game. No code copied.

entries.name: PlayStrategy strategygames
entries.by: Mind Sports Games (forked from lichess's scalachess)
entries.what: The server's Go rules and byo-yomi clock.
copying: Rules test positions adapted from strategygames

entries.name: OGS goban and goban-engine
entries.what: The board you play on, its themes drawn in code, the puzzle board, and the browser's Go rules.
copying: Rules test positions adapted from OGS goban

entries.name: goscorer
entries.what: Counts territory and area at the end of a game (inside goban).

entries.name: KataGo
entries.what: Proposes the dead stones when a game ends and checks every puzzle. Its test positions check LiGo's rules.

entries.name: KataGo's full-size network
entries.what: The trained network KataGo scores games with (downloaded to the server, not shipped with LiGo).

entries.name: KataGo's g170 test network
entries.what: The small network that checked the puzzles, shipped in KataGo's own repository.

entries.name: OGS goratings
entries.what: How ratings become kyu and dan ranks, and the handicap maths.

entries.name: @sabaki/sgf
entries.what: Reads and writes SGF game records in the browser.

entries.name: Sound sets: SFX, Piano, NES and Futuristic
entries.what: Every sound LiGo plays (they came with lichess).

entries.name: Noto Sans
entries.what: The site's text font.

entries.name: Roboto
entries.by: The Roboto Project Authors (designed by Christian Robertson)
entries.what: The site's secondary font.

entries.name: lichess icon font
entries.by: Dave Gandy, GitHub, Webalys, Zurb, Daniel Bruce, Shapemade, Sergey Shmidt and the lichess authors
entries.what: The site's icons.

entries.name: Flag icons
entries.what: Country flags on profiles.

entries.name: Everything else that came with lichess
entries.what: Other pictures still in the code until the chess leftovers go.

entries.name: LiGo's own puzzles (generated-001.json, 240 puzzles)
entries.what: Every tsumego on the site: each answer proved by an exact search, then checked by KataGo.

entries.name: KaTrain's tsumego frame
entries.by: Sander Land, ported from lizgoban by kaorahi
entries.what: Frames a puzzle so KataGo can check it.

entries.name: OGS's autoscore test games
entries.what: 31 finished games that check LiGo's dead-stone scoring.

entries.name: Small libraries
entries.what: eventemitter3, doken, joda-time, scala-parser-combinators, ioredis and its dependencies, ajv and its dependencies. Each is listed with its notice in COPYING.md.

entries.name: axe-core
entries.what: Checks LiGo's pages for accessibility problems in its tests (never sent to players).
